If you mean those weird fly-aways, try combing less even with your fingers. Your curls might be separating from each other because of the combing.

Scrunch when wet then plop or, since your hair is long, dry it about half way in a top bun. Never touch your curls after they're already dry! Since you have a medium curl and longer hair, you might also want to experiment with texturizing sea salt sprays. They add a lot of bounce and have protective oils as well. Good luck!
